title: Equality before law
text: The State shall not deny to any person equality before the law or the equal protection of the laws within the territory of India.
hi_summary: राज्य किसी भी व्यक्ति को कानून के सामने समानता और कानूनों के समान संरक्षण से वंचित नहीं करेगा।

title: Freedom of speech and expression
text: All citizens shall have the right to freedom of speech and expression. This right is subject to reasonable restrictions under Article 19(2), including in the interests of public order, decency, morality, and defamation.
hi_summary: हर नागरिक को बोलने और अभिव्यक्ति की स्वतंत्रता का अधिकार है, पर अनुच्छेद 19(2) के तहत उचित पाबंदियाँ लग सकती हैं।

title: Protection of life and personal liberty
text: No person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.
hi_summary: किसी भी व्यक्ति को कानून द्वारा स्थापित प्रक्रिया के बिना जीवन या व्यक्तिगत स्वतंत्रता से वंचित नहीं किया जा सकता।

title: Right to constitutional remedies
text: A person may move the Supreme Court of India directly for the enforcement of fundamental rights, including through writs such as habeas corpus, mandamus, prohibition, quo warranto and certiorari.
hi_summary: मौलिक अधिकारों के लिए कोई भी व्यक्ति सीधे सर्वोच्च न्यायालय जा सकता है और रिट माँग सकता है।

title: Duration of certain leases and notice to quit
text: A lease of immovable property from month to month is terminable by fifteen days' notice by either party. A lease from year to year is terminable by six months' notice. Notice must be in writing, signed, and served on the other party. A landlord cannot lawfully evict a monthly tenant without this notice, and cannot use force to evict; eviction requires following the legal process.
hi_summary: महीने-दर-महीने की लीज़ 15 दिन के लिखित नोटिस से खत्म की जा सकती है; बिना नोटिस और बिना कानूनी प्रक्रिया के मकान मालिक किरायेदार को बलपूर्वक नहीं निकाल सकता।

title: Determination of lease
text: A lease of immovable property determines by efflux of the time limited thereby, by surrender, by forfeiture, by merger, or on the happening of a specified event, among other modes listed in the section. Even after determination, a landlord must obtain possession through the lawful process and cannot forcibly evict a tenant.
hi_summary: लीज़ समय पूरा होने, समर्पण, जब्ती या विलय जैसे तरीकों से समाप्त होती है, पर कब्ज़ा पाने के लिए फिर भी कानूनी प्रक्रिया चाहिए।

title: Who is a consumer
text: A consumer is any person who buys goods or hires or avails of any service for a consideration which has been paid or promised, partly paid or promised, or under any system of deferred payment, and includes any beneficiary of such goods or service. A person who obtains goods for resale or for any commercial purpose is not a consumer.
hi_summary: उपभोक्ता वह है जो भुगतान करके सामान खरीदता है या सेवा लेता है; दोबारा बेचने या व्यापार के लिए खरीदने वाला उपभोक्ता नहीं है।

title: Unfair trade practice
text: An unfair trade practice means a trade practice which, for the purpose of promoting the sale, use or supply of any goods or for the provision of any service, adopts any unfair method or unfair or deceptive practice, including making a false or misleading representation about the quality, quantity, standard or price of goods or services.
hi_summary: अनुचित व्यापार प्रथा वह है जिसमें सामान या सेवा की गुणवत्ता, मात्रा या कीमत के बारे में गलत या भ्रामक बात कही जाए।

title: Where to file a consumer complaint
text: A complaint may be filed with the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission where the value of the goods or services paid as consideration does not exceed one crore rupees. Complaints above one crore rupees and up to ten crore rupees go to the State Commission, and above ten crore rupees to the National Commission.
hi_summary: एक करोड़ रुपये तक के मामलों में जिला आयोग में, एक करोड़ से दस करोड़ तक राज्य आयोग में और दस करोड़ से ऊपर राष्ट्रीय आयोग में शिकायत होती है।

title: Identity theft
text: Whoever, fraudulently or dishonestly, makes use of the electronic signature, password or any other unique identification feature of any other person is guilty of identity theft, and is punishable with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years and a fine which may extend to rupees one lakh.
hi_summary: किसी दूसरे व्यक्ति का पासवर्ड या पहचान चुराकर इस्तेमाल करना पहचान की चोरी है — तीन साल तक की कैद और एक लाख रुपये तक का जुर्माना हो सकता है।

title: Cheating by personation using a computer resource
text: Whoever, by means of any communication device or computer resource, cheats by personation is punishable with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years and a fine which may extend to rupees one lakh.
hi_summary: कंप्यूटर से किसी और का रूप धरकर ठगी करना अपराध है — तीन साल तक की कैद और एक लाख रुपये तक का जुर्माना हो सकता है।

title: Intermediary not liable in certain cases
text: An intermediary is not liable for any third-party information, data or communication link hosted by it, subject to conditions: the intermediary must not initiate the transmission, select the receiver, or modify the information, and must observe due diligence and remove unlawful content on receiving actual knowledge through a court or government order.
hi_summary: बिचौलिया (जैसे वेबसाइट) तीसरे पक्ष की सामग्री के लिए ज़िम्मेदार नहीं होता, जब तक वह शर्तें पूरी करे और अदालत या सरकार के आदेश पर गलत सामग्री हटाए।

title: Consent and duties of a Data Fiduciary
text: Personal data may be processed only with the free, specific, informed and unambiguous consent of the Data Principal, given through a clear affirmative action. A Data Fiduciary must take reasonable security safeguards to prevent a personal data breach, and must give notice to the affected Data Principals and the Data Protection Board of India when a breach occurs.
hi_summary: निजी डेटा सिर्फ डेटा धारक की सहमति से ही इस्तेमाल हो सकता है; डेटा रखने वाले को सुरक्षा के उपाय करने होंगे और डेटा चोरी होने पर सूचना देनी होगी।

title: Cheating
text: Cheating is defined in the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023: whoever, by deceiving any person, fraudulently or dishonestly induces that person to deliver any property, or to consent to the retention of property, or intentionally induces that person to do or omit to do anything which that person would not do or omit if not so deceived, commits cheating. Cheating is punishable with imprisonment which may extend to seven years and fine. The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita replaced the Indian Penal Code from 1 July 2024.
hi_summary: धोखा देकर किसी से संपत्ति दिलवाना या कुछ करवाना ठगी है — सात साल तक की कैद और जुर्माना हो सकता है।

title: Punishment for murder
text: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine. The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 replaced the Indian Penal Code from 1 July 2024, and its section numbers differ from the old Indian Penal Code.
hi_summary: हत्या करने पर मौत की सज़ा या आजीवन कारावास और जुर्माना हो सकता है।

title: Theft
text: Theft is defined in the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023: whoever, intending to take dishonestly any movable property out of the possession of any person without that person's consent, moves that property in order to such taking, is said to commit theft. Theft is punishable with imprisonment which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both. The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita replaced the Indian Penal Code from 1 July 2024.
hi_summary: बिना सहमति के किसी की चल संपत्ति लेना चोरी है — तीन साल तक की कैद, जुर्माना या दोनों हो सकते हैं।

title: First Information Report
text: Information relating to the commission of a cognizable offence, if given orally to an officer in charge of a police station, shall be reduced to writing, read over to the informant, and signed by the informant; a copy must be given free of cost to the informant. This is the First Information Report (FIR). The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 replaced the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 from 1 July 2024.
hi_summary: संज्ञेय अपराध की सूचना पुलिस को देने पर उसे लिखकर, पढ़कर सुनाकर और हस्ताक्षर करवाकर FIR दर्ज करनी होती है और उसकी मुफ्त कॉपी देनी होती है।

title: What agreements are contracts
text: All agreements are contracts if they are made by the free consent of parties competent to contract, for a lawful consideration and with a lawful object, and are not hereby expressly declared to be void.
hi_summary: कोई समझौता तभी अनुबंध है जब वह स्वतंत्र सहमति, योग्य पक्षों, वैध प्रतिफल और वैध उद्देश्य से बना हो।

title: Compensation for loss caused by breach of contract
text: When a contract has been broken, the party who suffers by such breach is entitled to receive compensation for any loss or damage caused to him thereby, which naturally arose in the usual course of things from such breach, or which the parties knew, when they made the contract, to be likely to result from the breach of it.
hi_summary: अनुबंध टूटने पर पीड़ित पक्ष को वह नुकसान भरपाई मिल सकती है जो सामान्य रूप से उस टूट से हुआ हो।

title: Private company
text: A private company is a company which has a minimum paid-up share capital as may be prescribed, restricts the right to transfer its shares, limits the number of its members to two hundred, and prohibits any invitation to the public to subscribe for any securities of the company.
hi_summary: प्राइवेट कंपनी वह है जिसमें शेयरों का हस्तांतरण सीमित हो, सदस्य 200 से ज़्यादा न हों और जनता को शेयर खरीदने का निमंत्रण न दिया जाए।

title: Company to have a Board of Directors
text: Every company shall have a Board of Directors consisting of individuals as directors. A private company must have a minimum of two directors, a public company a minimum of three directors, and a One Person Company a minimum of one director.
hi_summary: हर कंपनी में निदेशक मंडल होता है — प्राइवेट कंपनी में कम से कम दो, पब्लिक कंपनी में कम से कम तीन और वन पर्सन कंपनी में कम से कम एक निदेशक।

title: Request for information and time limit
text: A person who desires to obtain any information under the Right to Information Act shall make a request in writing or through electronic means to the Public Information Officer. The Public Information Officer must provide the information within thirty days of receiving the request, or reject it for reasons specified in the Act.
hi_summary: RTI के तहत सूचना लोक सूचना अधिकारी से माँगी जाती है और 30 दिन के अंदर देनी होती है।

title: No-fault liability in motor accidents
text: Where death or grievous hurt has resulted from an accident arising out of the use of a motor vehicle, the owner of the vehicle is liable to pay compensation of five lakh rupees in case of death and two lakh fifty thousand rupees in case of grievous hurt, without the claimant having to prove that the death or grievous hurt was due to any wrongful act, neglect or default of the owner or any other person.
hi_summary: मोटर दुर्घटना में मौत पर पाँच लाख और गंभीर चोट पर ढाई लाख रुपये का मुआवज़ा बिना गलती साबित किए मिलता है।

title: Grounds for divorce
text: A marriage may be dissolved by a decree of divorce on grounds including cruelty, desertion for a continuous period of not less than two years immediately preceding the petition, adultery, conversion to another religion, unsoundness of mind, leprosy, venereal disease, renunciation of the world, or where the other party has not been heard of as being alive for seven years or more.
hi_summary: तलाक क्रूरता, दो साल तक लगातार परित्याग, व्यभिचार, धर्म परिवर्तन, मानसिक बीमारी और अन्य कारणों से मिल सकता है।

title: Lease defined
text: A lease of immovable property is a transfer of a right to enjoy such property, made for a certain time or in perpetuity, in consideration of a price paid or promised, or of money, a share of crops, service or any other thing of value, to be rendered periodically or on specified occasions to the transferor by the transferee, who accepts the transfer on such terms.
hi_summary: लीज़ का मतलब है किसी अचल संपत्ति का उपयोग करने का अधिकार किसी समय के लिए देना, जिसके बदले में किराया या कोई और मूल्य दिया जाता है।

title: Leases how made
text: A lease of immovable property from year to year, or for any term exceeding one year, or reserving a yearly rent, can be made only by a registered instrument. All other leases of immovable property may be made either by a registered instrument or by oral agreement accompanied by delivery of possession.
hi_summary: साल-दर-साल की या एक साल से लंबी लीज़ सिर्फ रजिस्टर्ड दस्तावेज़ से बनती है; छोटी लीज मौखिक समझौते और कब्ज़ा सौंपने से भी बन सकती है।

title: Rights and liabilities of lessor and lessee
text: The lessor must disclose any material defect in the property, and the lessee must pay the rent, keep the property in as good condition as it was, and not use it for a purpose other than that for which it was leased. The lessee must also allow the lessor to inspect the property at reasonable times.
hi_summary: मकान मालिक को संपत्ति की बड़ी खराबी बतानी होती है और किरायेदार को किराया देना, संपत्ति को ठीक रखना और उसे तय काम के लिए ही इस्तेमाल करना होता है।

title: Sale defined
text: Sale is a transfer of ownership in exchange for a price paid or promised or part paid and part promised. Such transfer, in the case of tangible immoveable property of the value of one hundred rupees and upwards, can be made only by a registered instrument.
hi_summary: बिक्री का मतलब है कीमत के बदले मालिकी का हस्तांतरण; सौ रुपये या उससे ज़्यादा की अचल संपत्ति की बिक्री सिर्फ रजिस्टर्ड दस्तावेज़ से होती है।

title: Complaint defined
text: A complaint is any allegation in writing made by a complainant that an unfair contract or unfair trade practice has been adopted by a trader or service provider, that goods bought suffer from a defect, that a service suffers from a deficiency, or that a price charged is in excess of the price fixed by law or displayed on the goods.
hi_summary: शिकायत का मतलब है लिखित में आरोप कि व्यापारी ने अनुचित व्यापार किया, सामान खराब है, सेवा में कमी है, या कीमत कानून से ज़्यादा ली गई है।

title: Rights of consumers
text: The rights of consumers include the right to be protected against the marketing of goods and services that are hazardous to life and property, the right to be informed about the quality, quantity, price and standard of goods or services, the right to be assured of access to a variety of goods or services at competitive prices, the right to be heard, the right to seek redressal, and the right to consumer awareness.
hi_summary: उपभोक्ता के अधिकारों में सुरक्षा, सही जानकारी, पसंद, सुनवाई, शिकायत का निवारण और उपभोक्ता जागरूकता शामिल हैं।

title: Deficiency in service
text: Deficiency means any fault, imperfection, shortcoming or inadequacy in the quality, nature and manner of performance which is required to be maintained by or under any law, or which has been undertaken to be performed by a person in pursuance of a contract or otherwise in relation to any service.
hi_summary: सेवा में कमी का मतलब है सेवा की गुणवत्ता या तरीके में कोई दोष या कमी, जो कानून या अनुबंध के अनुसार होनी चाहिए थी।

title: Computer related offences
text: If any person, dishonestly or fraudulently, does any act referred to in section 43, he shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years or with fine which may extend to five lakh rupees or with both.
hi_summary: बेईमानी या धोखे से किसी के कंप्यूटर को नुकसान पहुँचाना अपराध है — तीन साल तक की कैद या पाँच लाख रुपये तक का जुर्माना हो सकता है।

title: Penalty and compensation for damage to computer
text: If any person without permission of the owner accesses or secures access to a computer, downloads or copies data, introduces a computer virus, damages or disrupts a computer, or denies access to an authorised person, he shall be liable to pay damages by way of compensation to the person so affected.
hi_summary: बिना अनुमति किसी के कंप्यूटर में घुसना, डेटा चुराना या वायरस डालना अपराध है और पीड़ित को मुआवज़ा देना होता है।

title: Cheating by personation
text: A person is said to cheat by personation if he cheats by pretending to be some other person, or by knowingly substituting one person for another, or representing that he or any other person is a person other than he or such other person really is. Cheating by personation is punishable with imprisonment and fine. The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita replaced the Indian Penal Code from 1 July 2024.
hi_summary: किसी और का रूप धरकर ठगी करना अपराध है — कैद और जुर्माना हो सकता है।

title: Voluntarily causing hurt
text: Whoever does any act with the intention of thereby causing hurt to any person, or with the knowledge that he is likely thereby to cause hurt to any person, and does thereby cause hurt to any person, is said to voluntarily cause hurt. It is punishable with imprisonment which may extend to one year, or with fine, or with both.
hi_summary: जानबूझकर किसी को चोट पहुँचाना अपराध है — एक साल तक की कैद, जुर्माना या दोनों हो सकते हैं।

title: Criminal intimidation
text: Whoever threatens another with any injury to his person, reputation or property, or to the person or reputation of any one in whom that person is interested, with intent to cause alarm to that person, or to cause that person to do any act which he is not legally bound to do, commits criminal intimidation. It is punishable with imprisonment which may extend to two years, or with fine, or with both.
hi_summary: किसी को चोट, बदनामी या संपत्ति के नुकसान की धमकी देकर डराना अपराध है — दो साल तक की कैद, जुर्माना या दोनों हो सकते हैं।

title: Defamation
text: Whoever, by words either spoken or intended to be read, or by signs or by visible representations, makes or publishes any imputation concerning any person intending to harm, or knowing or having reason to believe that such imputation will harm, the reputation of such person, is said to defame that person. Defamation is punishable with simple imprisonment for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine, or with both, or with community service.
hi_summary: किसी की बदनामी के लिए झूठा आरोप लगाना या छापना मानहानि है — दो साल तक की कैद, जुर्माना या सामुदायिक सेवा हो सकती है।

title: Dishonour of cheque for insufficiency of funds
text: Where any cheque drawn by a person on an account maintained by him with a banker for payment of any amount of money to another person is returned by the bank unpaid, either because the amount of money standing to the credit of that account is insufficient to honour the cheque or because it exceeds the amount arranged to be paid from that account, such person shall be deemed to have committed an offence. It is punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine which may extend to twice the amount of the cheque, or with both.
hi_summary: खाते में पैसे न होने से चेक बाउंस होना अपराध है — दो साल तक की कैद या चेक की रकम से दोगुना तक जुर्माना हो सकता है।

title: Presumption in favour of holder
text: It shall be presumed, unless the contrary is proved, that the holder of a cheque received the cheque for the discharge, in whole or in part, of any debt or other liability.
hi_summary: अदालत यह मानकर चलती है कि चेक किसी कर्ज़ या देनदारी के भुगतान के लिए मिला था, जब तक उल्टा साबित न हो।

title: Cognizance of offences
text: No court shall take cognizance of an offence under section 138 except upon a complaint in writing made by the payee or the holder in due course of the cheque. The complaint must be made within one month of the date on which the cause of action arises, after the payee has served a demand notice and fifteen days have passed without payment.
hi_summary: चेक बाउंस की शिकायत सिर्फ चेक पाने वाला लिखित में कर सकता है — पहले 15 दिन का नोटिस देना होता है, फिर एक महीने के अंदर शिकायत करनी होती है।

title: Divorce by mutual consent
text: A petition for dissolution of marriage by a decree of divorce may be presented by both the parties to a marriage together, on the ground that they have been living separately for a period of one year or more, that they have not been able to live together, and that they have mutually agreed that the marriage should be dissolved.
hi_summary: पति-पत्नी दोनों की सहमति से तलाक मिल सकता है, अगर वे एक साल या उससे ज़्यादा से अलग रह रहे हों और दोनों तलाक चाहते हों।

title: Maintenance pendente lite
text: Where in any proceeding under this Act it appears to the court that either the wife or the husband has no independent income sufficient for her or his support and the necessary expenses of the proceeding, it may order the respondent to pay to the petitioner the expenses of the proceeding and monthly maintenance during the proceeding.
hi_summary: तलाक की कार्यवाही के दौरान जिस पक्ष की अपनी आमदनी न हो, अदालत उसे मुकदमे का खर्च और मासिक भरण-पोषण दिलवा सकती है।

title: Permanent alimony and maintenance
text: Any court exercising jurisdiction under this Act may, at the time of passing any decree or at any time subsequent thereto, on application made by either the wife or the husband, order that the respondent shall pay to the applicant for her or his maintenance and support such gross sum or such monthly or periodical sum for a term not exceeding the life of the applicant.
hi_summary: तलाक के फैसले के समय या बाद में भी अदालत एक पक्ष को दूसरे से स्थायी भरण-पोषण (एकमुश्त या मासिक) दिलवा सकती है।

title: Maintenance of wives, children and parents
text: If any person having sufficient means neglects or refuses to maintain his wife, his legitimate or illegitimate child, or his father or mother who is unable to maintain herself or himself, a Magistrate of the first class may order such person to make a monthly allowance for the maintenance of his wife, child, father or mother. The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita replaced the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 from 1 July 2024.
hi_summary: अगर कोई व्यक्ति अपनी पत्नी, बच्चों या माता-पिता का भरण-पोषण नहीं करता, तो मजिस्ट्रेट उसे मासिक भत्ता देने का आदेश दे सकता है।

title: When police may arrest without warrant
text: Any police officer may without an order from a Magistrate and without a warrant arrest any person who commits, in the presence of a police officer, a cognizable offence, or against whom a reasonable complaint has been made or credible information has been received that he has committed a cognizable offence punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to more than seven years.
hi_summary: पुलिस कुछ मामलों में बिना वारंट के गिरफ्तार कर सकती है — जैसे संज्ञेय अपराध उसके सामने हुआ हो या उसकी विश्वसनीय शिकायत मिली हो।

title: Bail in bailable offences
text: When any person is arrested or detained without a warrant by an officer in charge of a police station, or appears or is brought before a court, and is prepared at any time while in the custody of such officer or at any stage of the proceeding before such court to give bail, such person shall be released on bail.
hi_summary: जमानती अपराध में गिरफ्तार व्यक्ति जमानत देने पर रिहा किया जाना चाहिए — यह उसका अधिकार है।

title: Bail in non-bailable offences
text: When any person accused of, or suspected of, the commission of any non-bailable offence is arrested or detained without warrant by an officer in charge of a police station, or appears or is brought before a court, he may be released on bail by the court, subject to conditions such as appearing before the court and not committing a similar offence while on bail.
hi_summary: गैर-जमानती अपराध में भी अदालत शर्तों पर जमानत दे सकती है — जैसे अदालत में हाज़िर होना और जमानत पर रहते हुए दोबारा अपराध न करना।

title: General rules of succession for a male Hindu
text: The property of a male Hindu dying intestate shall devolve according to the rules in the Schedule: firstly, upon the heirs specified in class I of the Schedule, who take the property simultaneously and to the exclusion of all other heirs, and if there is no class I heir, upon the heirs in class II, then upon the agnates, then upon the cognates.
hi_summary: बिना वसीयत मरे हुए हिंदू पुरुष की संपत्ति पहले प्रथम श्रेणी के वारिसों को मिलती है, फिर द्वितीय श्रेणी, फिर अन्य रिश्तेदारों को।

title: Testamentary succession
text: Any Hindu may dispose of by will or other testamentary disposition any property which is capable of being so disposed of by him or by her, in accordance with the provisions of the Indian Succession Act, 1925, or any other law for the time being in force and applicable to Hindus.
hi_summary: कोई भी हिंदू अपनी संपत्ति का निपटारा वसीयत से कर सकता है।

title: Execution of unprivileged wills
text: Every testator, not being a soldier employed in an expedition or engaged in actual warfare or a mariner at sea, shall execute his will according to the following rules: the testator shall sign or shall affix his mark to the will, and the will shall be attested by two or more witnesses, each of whom has seen the testator sign or affix his mark, and each of whom shall sign the will in the presence of the testator.
hi_summary: साधारण वसीयत लिखित में होनी चाहिए, वसीयतकर्ता के हस्ताक्षर होने चाहिए और दो गवाहों के हस्ताक्षर ज़रूरी हैं।

title: Application for compensation
text: An application for compensation arising out of an accident of the nature specified in section 165 may be made to the Claims Tribunal by the person who has sustained the injury, or by the owner of the property, or where death has resulted from the accident, by all or any of the legal representatives of the deceased.
hi_summary: मोटर दुर्घटना का मुआवज़ा माँगने के लिए घायल व्यक्ति या मृतक के कानूनी वारिस क्लेम ट्रिब्यूनल में आवेदन कर सकते हैं।

title: Driving under the influence of drugs or alcohol
text: Whoever, while driving or attempting to drive a motor vehicle, has alcohol in his blood exceeding 30 mg per 100 ml of blood, or is under the influence of a drug to such an extent as to be incapable of exercising proper control over the vehicle, shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months, or with fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees, or with both, for a first offence.
hi_summary: नशे में गाड़ी चलाना अपराध है — पहली बार में छह महीने तक की कैद या दस हज़ार रुपये तक का जुर्माना हो सकता है।

title: Exemption from disclosure
text: Information is exempt from disclosure where its disclosure would prejudicially affect the sovereignty and integrity of India, the security, strategic, scientific or economic interests of the State, relations with foreign States, or would lead to incitement of an offence, among other specified grounds.
hi_summary: कुछ जानकारी RTI में नहीं मिलती — जैसे देश की सुरक्षा, संप्रभुता या विदेशी संबंधों से जुड़ी जानकारी।

title: Appeal
text: Any person who does not receive a decision within the time specified, or is aggrieved by a decision of the Public Information Officer, may within thirty days from the expiry of such period or from the receipt of such decision prefer an appeal to an officer senior in rank to the Public Information Officer. A second appeal against the decision lies to the Central Information Commission or the State Information Commission within ninety days.
hi_summary: अगर सूचना न मिले या जवाब से संतुष्टि न हो, तो 30 दिन के अंदर वरिष्ठ अधिकारी से अपील और 90 दिन के अंदर सूचना आयोग से दूसरी अपील की जा सकती है।

title: Penalties
text: Where the Central Information Commission or the State Information Commission is of the opinion that the Public Information Officer has, without any reasonable cause, refused to receive an application, not furnished information within the time specified, or knowingly given incorrect or misleading information, it shall impose a penalty of two hundred and fifty rupees each day till the information is furnished, up to a maximum of twenty-five thousand rupees.
hi_summary: अगर लोक सूचना अधिकारी बिना कारण सूचना न दे या गलत जानकारी दे, तो उस पर हर दिन 250 रुपये, कुल ज़्यादा से ज़्यादा 25,000 रुपये का जुर्माना लग सकता है।

title: Processing of personal data of children
text: A Data Fiduciary shall not undertake any processing of personal data of a child that is likely to cause any detrimental effect on the well-being of the child, and shall not undertake tracking or behavioural monitoring of children or targeted advertising directed at children. Processing of a child's personal data requires verifiable consent of the parent or lawful guardian.
hi_summary: बच्चों का डेटा सिर्फ माता-पिता की सहमति से इस्तेमाल हो सकता है; बच्चों की ट्रैकिंग या लक्षित विज्ञापन नहीं किया जा सकता।

title: Rights of the Data Principal
text: The Data Principal shall have the right to obtain information about the personal data being processed, to seek correction and erasure of personal data, to seek grievance redressal, and to nominate any other individual who shall, in the event of death or incapacity of the Data Principal, exercise the rights of the Data Principal.
hi_summary: जिसका डेटा है, उसे अपना डेटा देखने, गलती सुधारने, डेटा मिटवाने, शिकायत करने और किसी को नामित करने का अधिकार है।

title: Penalties
text: If the Data Protection Board of India determines that a Data Fiduciary has breached the Act, the Board may impose a monetary penalty of up to two hundred and fifty crore rupees, depending on the nature and gravity of the breach.
hi_summary: अगर डेटा रखने वाला कानून तोड़ता है, तो डेटा सुरक्षा बोर्ड उस पर ढाई सौ करोड़ रुपये तक का जुर्माना लगा सकता है।

title: Conditions precedent to retrenchment
text: No workman employed in any industry who has been in continuous service for not less than one year under an employer shall be retrenched by that employer until the workman has been given one month's notice in writing indicating the reasons for retrenchment and the period of notice has expired, or the workman has been paid in lieu of such notice wages for the period of the notice, and the workman has been paid compensation equivalent to fifteen days' average pay for every completed year of continuous service.
hi_summary: एक साल से काम कर रहे मज़दूर को निकालने से पहले एक महीने का नोटिस या उसके बदले वेतन और हर पूरे साल के लिए 15 दिन का मुआवज़ा देना ज़रूरी है।

title: Payment of gratuity
text: Gratuity shall be payable to an employee on the termination of his employment after he has rendered continuous service for not less than five years, on his superannuation, on his retirement or resignation, or on his death or disablement due to accident or disease. The gratuity is fifteen days' wages for every completed year of service, subject to a maximum of twenty lakh rupees.
hi_summary: पाँच साल लगातार काम करने के बाद नौकरी छूटने, सेवानिवृत्ति या इस्तीफे पर ग्रेच्युटी मिलती है — हर साल के लिए 15 दिन का वेतन, ज़्यादा से ज़्यादा 20 लाख रुपये तक।

title: Right to payment of maternity benefit
text: Every woman employed in an establishment shall be entitled to the payment of maternity benefit at the rate of the average daily wage for the period of her actual absence, for a maximum period of twenty-six weeks for the first two children, of which not more than eight weeks shall precede the date of her expected delivery.
hi_summary: पहले दो बच्चों के लिए महिला को 26 हफ्ते की सवेतन छुट्टी मिलती है, जिसमें से 8 हफ्ते तक प्रसव से पहले ली जा सकती है।

title: Payment of minimum rates of wages
text: Where in respect of any scheduled employment a notification is in force, the employer shall pay to every employee engaged in that employment wages at a rate not less than the minimum rate of wages fixed by that notification for that class of employees.
hi_summary: जिस काम के लिए न्यूनतम वेतन तय है, उसमें मालिक को तय न्यूनतम वेतन से कम नहीं देना चाहिए।

title: Documents of which registration is compulsory
text: The following documents shall be registered: non-testamentary instruments which purport or operate to create, declare, assign, limit or extinguish any right, title or interest in immovable property, and leases of immovable property from year to year, or for any term exceeding one year, or reserving a yearly rent.
hi_summary: अचल संपत्ति का हक़ बदलने वाले दस्तावेज़ और एक साल से लंबी लीज़ का रजिस्ट्रेशन करवाना ज़रूरी है।

title: Effect of non-registration
text: No document required to be registered shall affect any immovable property comprised therein, or be received as evidence of any transaction affecting such property, unless it has been registered. An unregistered document may, however, be used as evidence of a collateral transaction or for specific performance of a contract.
hi_summary: जिस दस्तावेज़ का रजिस्ट्रेशन ज़रूरी है, वह बिना रजिस्ट्रेशन के संपत्ति पर असर नहीं डालता और सबूत के तौर पर नहीं लिया जाता।

title: Agreement to do impossible act
text: An agreement to do an act impossible in itself is void. A contract to do an act which, after the contract is made, becomes impossible, or by reason of some event which the promisor could not prevent becomes unlawful, becomes void when the act becomes impossible or unlawful.
hi_summary: जो काम करना असंभव है, उसका समझौता शून्य होता है; अगर अनुबंध के बाद काम असंभव हो जाए, तो अनुबंध उसी समय शून्य हो जाता है।

title: Prohibition of discrimination
text: The State shall not discriminate against any citizen on grounds only of religion, race, caste, sex, place of birth or any of them.
hi_summary: राज्य किसी भी नागरिक के साथ धर्म, जाति, लिंग या जन्मस्थान के आधार पर भेदभाव नहीं कर सकता।

title: Power of High Courts to issue writs
text: Every High Court shall have power to issue to any person or authority directions, orders or writs, including writs in the nature of habeas corpus, mandamus, prohibition, quo warranto and certiorari, for the enforcement of any of the rights conferred by Part III and for any other purpose.
hi_summary: हर उच्च न्यायालय मौलिक अधिकारों और अन्य मामलों के लिए रिट जारी कर सकता है।

title: One Person Company
text: One Person Company means a company which has only one person as a member.
hi_summary: वन पर्सन कंपनी वह है जिसमें सिर्फ एक ही सदस्य होता है।

act: Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017
title: Eligibility for input tax credit
text: Every registered person shall be entitled to take credit of input tax charged on any supply of goods or services or both to him which are used or intended to be used in the course or furtherance of his business, subject to the conditions and restrictions in the Act, including that he is in possession of a tax invoice and has received the goods or services.
hi_summary: रजिस्टर्ड व्यापारी अपने व्यापार के लिए खरीदी गई वस्तुओं या सेवाओं पर चुकाए गए GST का क्रेडिट ले सकता है, अगर उसके पास टैक्स इनवॉइस हो और सामान मिला हो।

act: Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017
title: Penalty for certain offences
text: Where a taxable person supplies goods or services without issuing an invoice, or issues an invoice without supplying goods or services, or collects tax but fails to pay it to the Government, he shall be liable to pay a penalty of ten thousand rupees or an amount equivalent to the tax evaded or the tax not deducted, whichever is higher.
hi_summary: बिना इनवॉइस के सामान बेचना या टैक्स लेकर सरकार को न देना अपराध है — दस हज़ार रुपये या छिपाए गए टैक्स के बराबर, जो ज़्यादा हो, जुर्माना लग सकता है।

title: Return of income
text: Every person whose total income during the previous year exceeded the maximum amount which is not chargeable to income-tax shall furnish a return of his income in the prescribed form and verified in the prescribed manner.
hi_summary: जिसकी आमदनी टैक्स छूट की सीमा से ज़्यादा है, उसे अपनी आय का रिटर्न भरना होता है।
